description: No clean concept for most firing. Its strongest activations come when the opponent has an open vertical three in column 5 (three of their stones stacked from the floor, cell above empty), usually just played; similar floor stacks in columns 0 and 6 are weaker. Most firing near the threshold is spread across varied positions with no common pattern; column-5 threats of other kinds (horizontal, diagonal) do not drive it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.01 on five positions.
notes: Layer 1. Top 0.1% band: about 70% are opponent col-5 floor triples. Bands 5-7 (most firing) diffuse. Scores: p1 col5/0/6 pure floor stack F1 0.223 AUROC 0.60; must-block in col 5 F1 0.16; col-5 floor stack (any last move) F1 0.20. Sim share 0.00 everywhere; steer shows no effect. Activation is sensitive to unrelated stones. Possibly a random direction or mixture. Two synthesis positions beat the dev max (1.39, 1.37).
